title: Swords & Wizardry
description: You can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from the Wizard's **Abjuration** or **Evocation** Schools.

outcomes.text:
When you swing your weapon, you can choose to **Cast a Spell** (instead of **Trade Blows**).

At the start of each session, you get Aether equal to your int. When you **Cast a Spell**, On a 7-9, you can spend Aether equal to the spell's mag instead of the other options.

title: Arcane Shield
description: When you suffer dmg, you may spend 1 Aether to reduce it by your int (min 0).

outcomes.text: When you **open your senses to the magic surrounding you**, the GM will tell you what you sense. Then you may spend 1 Aether to ask a number of the following questions equal to your int:
bullets: What type of magic is it?

title: ESP (Extrasensory Perception)
description: When you **magically connect with an important object for the first time**, roll+int.

outcomes.text: Ask the GM two questions about its history, origins, functionalities, properties, etc.
The item curses or haunts you; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Magebane
description: When an NPC **close** to you is about to create a magical effect, you can spend 1 Aether to lunge towards them to try and interrupt them; roll+str.

outcomes.text: The magic is diminished or redirected (GM's call).
Your intervention makes things worse; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
When **an NPC within** **hand** **reach of you creates a magical effect**, you inflict min dmg on them, even if you just lunged towards them with this move.
